title: Trello Automation - Webhooks/Push Investigation
goal: Investigate and implement automated triggers for Trello card state changes via Xano webhook receiver

userStories.story: As Zak, I want to be notified when a card moves to In Progress so I can start working immediately
As Zak, I want to be notified when a card moves from Review back to In Progress for iteration
As Bill, I want cards auto-processed based on state changes for hands-off workflow

acceptanceCriteria: Notifications delivered on card moves to In Progress
outOfScope: Full implementation of all automation scenarios (this is MVP/proof of concept)

plan.notes: Webhooks confirmed: POST callbacks, HMAC-SHA1 signing, retry logic
Full code spec in card description
Xano + Telegram = simplest path; no Clawdbot webhook exposure needed

implementationSteps: Deploy Xano endpoint code from spec
Set TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN env var in Xano

trelloWebhookPayload.action: Contains action type (updateCard) and data (listBefore, listAfter)
